verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents and runtime-probes confirm appending .md to any page URL serves clean markdown (mintlify-docs-9, mintlify-docs-23), and a live runtime probe verified this on their own docs site (quickstart.md returned markdown content) confirming it works in practice, not just in theory. missing for 10: independent third-party (non-Mintlify) customer site confirmation that .md works uniformly across all published docs sites.
